faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Here are some of the most common questions about Unwatermark.

items.question: What is Unwatermark and how can it help me?
items.answer: Unwatermark is a focused image cleanup tool that removes visible watermarks, logos, and text overlays from images you have the right to edit.

items.question: What file types does Unwatermark support for watermark removal?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, PNG, and WEBP images up to 10 MB. Results keep the same format and resolution as the source.

items.question: Can I remove watermarks from AI-generated images or videos?
items.answer: Yes, you can process screenshots and single frames from AI-generated images. For full videos, please export the frames you need first.

items.question: Does Unwatermark support batch watermark removal?
items.answer: The MVP processes one image at a time so each result can be reviewed before download. Multi-image workflows are on the roadmap.

items.question: Does Unwatermark support usage on Android or iOS devices?
items.answer: The site works in any modern mobile browser, so you can upload and download from Android or iOS without installing an app.

items.question: Is Unwatermark completely free?
items.answer: There is a free tier for occasional use. Paid credit packs unlock higher resolution and larger queues when you need them.

items.question: Why does the system tell me I have exceeded my free limit?
items.answer: The free tier limits the number of images you can process per day. Limits reset on a rolling 24-hour window or when you upgrade.

items.question: Will purchased credits expire?
items.answer: Credits remain valid for 12 months from the purchase date. We will remind you before any credits expire.

items.question: How do I need to choose the right package?
items.answer: Pick a package based on how many images you process each month and the resolution you need. You can upgrade or top up at any time.
